text: Refills can change after the visit. The family stops a medication, or the doctor wants fewer or more. You do that on the pet's chart.
Here's Maple's chart. Click the Rx tab.
Every prescription is here, including the ones from eVet.
You see the doctor's directions, and how many refills are left.
and click Save refills. Doctors and techs can lower refills or stop them. Adding refills is for a licensed vet only.
If the family stops the medication, click Stop refills.
Now there are none left, so nobody can refill it by mistake.
Need different directions? Never change a refill. New directions stops this prescription and writes a new script under the doctor, starting from the item's usual directions.
Every change is logged. Click History.
Here's who stopped the refills, and when.
One more rule: once a doctor hasn't seen the pet for a year, refills can't be used. The pet needs an exam first.
Two mistakes to avoid: changing directions on a refill, and leaving refills on a medication the family stopped. Stop the refills, or write a new script.
